publisher: Arizona Department of Health Services Vital Statistics
title: Heat-Related Illness (HRI) Emergency Department and Inpatient Admissions 2021-2025, Arizona Residents and Non-Residents
geography: County of residence = Maricopa; Arizona residents only; not Phoenix city and not hospital county
count_unit: ED visits and inpatient admissions; unique-patient deduplication is not documented on the cited methods page.

caused_vs_related_definition.note: heat-caused means primary diagnosis exposure to excessive natural heat; heat-related means heat in any diagnosis and includes heat-caused

methods: CSTE-adapted criteria; search entire Hospital Discharge Data record for ICD-10 codes T67.0-T67.9 and X30.
ICD codes for manmade heat sources are excluded.

New more flexible wildcard database search introduced beginning in 2025 and applied retrospectively to previous data years in reports published 2025 onward; same inclusion/exclusion codes. Older reports annual totals may differ.
Crude rates per 100,000 population, denominators official ADHS Vital Statistics population estimates.
County tables headed County Residence / Arizona Residents Only.
limitations: No individual de-duplication method, ED-to-inpatient overlap exclusion, or explicit counts mutual exclusivity is stated on methods page; do not add counts and label unique persons.
County-level observations cannot identify city/district exposure or demonstrate cooling facility causal effects.
Use a single release for time comparisons, not mix old report annual totals.
